literary_periods.theme: Oral epics, Bathou devotional chants, folk ballads and early missionary translations.
Renaissance of written Bodo literature sparked by Gurudev Kalicharan Brahma, Bibar journal (1924), and student congresses.
Establishment of Bodo Sahitya Sabha (1952), script movement, school textbooks, and social realism in poetry.
Recognition under Eighth Schedule (2003), Sahitya Akademi awards, modern novels, and literary critique.

prominent_authors.name: Gurudev Kalicharan Brahma
prominent_authors.role: Social reformer, philosopher, pioneer of Bodo social renaissance and Brahma Dharma movement.

prominent_authors.name: Satish Chandra Basumatary
prominent_authors.role: Chief editor of 'Bibar' (1924), dramatist, songwriter, pioneer of modern Bodo drama.

prominent_authors.name: Modaram Brahma
prominent_authors.role: Eminent poet, dramatist, educationist; composer of prayers, Padma Shri recipient.

prominent_authors.name: Rupnath Brahma
prominent_authors.role: Statesman, poet, dramatist; author of early mystic songs and religious texts.

prominent_authors.name: Kamal Kumar Brahma
prominent_authors.role: Distinguished dramatist, folklorist, pioneer of modern Bodo theatre.

prominent_authors.name: Bihuram Boro
prominent_authors.role: Poet, linguist, author of critical treatises on Bodo syntax and prosody.

prominent_authors.name: Dharanidhar Wary
prominent_authors.role: Folklorist, collector of Bodo folktales, Sahitya Akademi awardee.

prominent_authors.name: Nilkamal Brahma
prominent_authors.role: Renowned short story writer, master of Bodo prose and social portrayal.

anthology_poems.devanagari_verse:
बैसागुनि बार बाबाय, गोदान बोथोर फैबाय,
दैसा-दैयाव दै बुंफबबाय, बिबार बारबाय दैमा सेराव।
गोबां साननि उनाव बोथोर सिलायबाय,
मानसिफोरनि गोसोआव रंजानाय बुंफबबाय।
anthology_poems.roman_transcription:
Bwisagu ni bar babay, gwdan bwthwr fwibay,
Dwisao-dwyao dwi bungfwbbay, bibar barbay dwima serao.
Gwbaw sanni unao bwthwr silaybay,
Mansiphorni goswao rwangjanay bungfwbbay.
anthology_poems.english_translation:
The gentle breeze of spring has whispered; the new year has dawned,
Streams swell with fresh mountain water; blossoms unveil along the riverbank.
After long weary days the winter season departs,
And radiant joy fills every beating human heart.
anthology_poems.theme: Nature renewal, New Year joyous awakening, pastoral bliss.

anthology_poems.devanagari_verse:
आं बर', आं बर' हारिनि फिसा,
हाग्रामायाव आंनि जोनोम, दैमायाव आंनि गोजां जिउ।
गिबि बैसोनिफ्राय आं गावनि हारिखौ मोजां मोनो,
बाथौनि सिजौ गांसेयाव आंनि जिउनि सिमां।
anthology_poems.roman_transcription:
Ang Boro, ang Boro harini fisa,
Hagramayao angni jwnwm, dwimayao angni gwojang jiu.
Gibi bwisonifray ang gawni harikhwo mwjang mwnw,
Bathouni Sijou gangseyao angni jiuni simang.
anthology_poems.english_translation:
I am Bodo, son of an ancient lineage,
Born of the deep wild woodlands, nurtured by crystalline streams.
From early infancy I hold my community dear to my soul,
In the sacred five ribs of the Sijou tree resides my life's vision.
anthology_poems.theme: Indigenous identity, dignity, devotion to ancestral roots.

anthology_poems.devanagari_verse:
मैनाव बुरै फैबाय दैमा बासिनानै,
माइबाख्रियाव बाहागो होफैबाय रंजानानै।
दंफांनि गांसे बिलाइयावबो दावसि मोसादों,
आथिखालनि संसारआव बर'नि मैनाव गोजोन होफैबाय।
anthology_poems.roman_transcription:
Mainao burwi fwibay dwima basinanwi,
Maibakhriyao bahagw hwfwibay rwangjananwi.
Dongfangni gangse bilaiyaobo daosi mosadwng,
Athikhalni swnsarao Bworoni Mainao gwojwn hwfwibay.
anthology_poems.english_translation:
Mother Mainao descends across gentle flowing waters,
Filling empty granaries with golden abundance and mirth.
Upon every woodland leaf the birds flutter in graceful dance,
Granting tranquility and blessing to the Bodo hearth.
